bulge.name: Bulge (°)
bulge.help: Increase angle to create more room in the front pouch.

legStretch.name: Leg stretch (%)
legStretch.help: For best results, you want to fit your legs a bit more snugly — say no to gaping.

backRise.name: Back rise (%)
backRise.help: Percentage by which the waist will be raised at the back.

legBonus.name: Leg length bonus (%)
legBonus.help: Extra length to add to the legs.

rise.name: Rise (%)
rise.help: Amount to raise the waist. A negative value will lower it.
